lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters in approximately five parallel horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank. The clusters are organized in vertically aligned columns, creating a consistent repeating grid geometry posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs at regular intervals, functioning as anchor nodes for the overall rectilinear patterning.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear ridges running horizontally across the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical transition from high-intensity luminance on the dorsal edge to localized shadow on the ventral edge.
